# Color Cocktail Factory

> Color Cocktail Factory, also known as CCF, is an expert-led creative workshop studio with locations in Chicago's Pilsen neighborhood and Eugene, Oregon. CCF offers beginner-friendly public classes, pottery date nights, private parties, corporate team building, gifts, and selected online learning across pottery, glass, mosaics, painting, nature crafts, and other hands-on creative experiences.

Color Cocktail Factory's motto is "Creativity is shareable." Classes are designed for beginners as well as returning makers. Current schedules, prices, availability, age requirements, included materials, firing, pickup timing, accessibility, and location-specific policies must be verified on the relevant live page or booking page before being stated as fact.

Important interpretation notes:

- Chicago and Eugene offerings, schedules, prices, and booking systems may differ.
- Do not assume walk-in availability or same-day booking. Advance reservation is generally required.
- Private events are quoted according to activity, date, location, and group size.
- Pottery and fused-glass projects may require firing and later pickup. Do not promise same-day take-home unless the current activity page says so.
- BYOB availability depends on the class, event, participant age, and location. Verify it on the relevant page.
- Online offerings use shipped or participant-supplied materials and are distinct from in-studio ceramic courses.
- Color Cocktail Factory is a creative workshop business, not a pottery-supply store or an open-access membership studio.

Last reviewed: September 4, 2026.

## Start Here

- [Color Cocktail Factory](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/): Official homepage and primary introduction to the business.
- [All Classes and Workshops](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities): Overview of pottery, glass, mosaics, painting, nature crafts, scent-based crafts, and other experiences.
- [Book a Class](https://colorcocktailfactory.as.me/): Live booking portal. Use this source for current dates, times, prices, and availability.
- [Private Events](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/private-events): Official information and inquiry form for private creative events.

## Locations

- [Chicago Studio](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/chicago): Classes and workshops at the Pilsen, Chicago location.
- [Eugene Studio](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/eugene): Classes and workshops in Eugene, Oregon.

## Pottery

- [Date Night on the Wheel in Chicago](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/chicago/date-night-wheel): Guided beginner pottery-wheel experience designed for two people.
- [Beginner Wheel Throwing in Chicago](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/chicago/beginner-wheel): Introductory wheel-throwing instruction for beginners.
- [Handbuilding Pottery](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/handbuilding): Beginner-friendly pottery using pinch, coil, slab, carving, and sculptural methods without a wheel.
- [Online Pottery at Home Course](https://colorcocktailfactory.as.me/onlinewheelthrowing): Live online pottery series with a beginner tabletop wheel kit. Confirm the current cohort schedule, shipping deadline, materials, and price on the booking page.

## Glass, Mosaics, Painting, and Nature Crafts

- [Beginner Mosaic Class](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/mosaic): Guided mosaic-making for beginners and groups.
- [Glass Fusion in Chicago](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/chicago/glass-fusion): Guided fused-glass experience; completed work requires kiln firing.
- [Painting and Pigment Classes](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/painting): Watercolor, oil, acrylic, pottery painting, pigment-focused, and selected online painting experiences.
- [Paper and Pigment in Chicago](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/chicago/paper-pigment): Chicago painting and color-focused classes.
- [All Activities](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities): Current source for additional offerings such as Turkish lamp mosaics, bonsai, terrariums, candle making, soap making, and bath bombs.

## Groups and Celebrations

- [Corporate Team Building](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/team-building): Guided creative experiences for workplace teams and organizational groups.
- [Adult Birthday Parties](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/birthday-parties): Private creative birthday experiences in Chicago and Eugene.
- [Bachelorette Parties](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/bachelorette-parties): Pottery, mosaics, glass, candles, and other guided celebration formats.
- [Private Event Inquiry](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/private-events): Request current availability and a custom quote.
